title: Quantifying System-Level Harms from AI Adoption in Complex Sociotechnical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.23906v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into complex sociotechnical systems, including Critical National Infrastructure (CNI), where harms emerge from interactions between technical, human, and organisational elements. Yet current AI evaluation remains model-centric, offering little insight into how observed behaviours might translate into system-level risk. We propose a framework that links structured hazard analysis, component-level testing, and probabilistic system modelling to bridge this gap. By providing a traceable pathway from model behaviour to system-level outcomes, the framework enables practitioners to answer the "so what?" of AI failures, quantify their systemic impact, and move toward evidence-based and anticipatory governance of AI in complex systems. Applied to the UK's Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system as an illustrative worked example, we derive AI-driven loss scenarios using Systems Theoretic Pro

translated_title: 量化复杂社会技术系统中AI采用带来的系统级危害
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23906v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人工智能（AI）日益融入复杂的社会技术系统，包括关键国家基础设施（CNI），在这些系统中，危害源于技术、人力和组织元素之间的相互作用。然而，当前的AI评估仍以模型为中心，对观察到的行为如何转化为系统级风险提供的洞察有限。我们提出了一个框架，将结构化危害分析、组件级测试和概率系统建模相结合，以弥合这一差距。通过提供从模型行为到系统级结果的可追溯路径，该框架使从业者能够回答AI失败的“那又怎样”问题，量化其系统性影响，并推动复杂系统中AI的循证和前瞻性治理。以英国实时总额结算（RTGS）系统作为示例性工作案例，我们使用系统理论过程分析（STPA）推导出AI驱动的损失场景。
tldr: 该论文提出一个结合结构化危害分析、组件测试和概率建模的框架，用于量化AI在复杂系统（如关键基础设施）中失败的系统级影响，并通过英国RTGS系统的案例展示了其应用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework combining structured hazard analysis, component testing, and probabilistic modeling to quantify the system-level impacts of AI failures in complex systems like critical infrastructure, demonstrated through a UK RTGS system case study.
